name: Tennis Buddee
tagline: A smart tennis racket that feels every shot.
category: smart sports device (sensor hardware + apps + Meta AI agent)

meta_technology.name: Muse Spark
meta_technology.use: tool-calling agent (10 native function-calling tools) over the player's shots and the live racket; predicts swing-change outcomes via a physics simulator

meta_technology.name: Muse Spark server proxy
meta_technology.use: Supabase edge function holds the Baseten API key; calls POST https://inference.baseten.co/v1/chat/completions

meta_technology.name: Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit
meta_technology.use: live HUD on Meta Ray-Ban Display (latest shot, sweet-spot rate, score, drill progress)

meta_technology.name: Meta SAM 3.1
meta_technology.use: video + image APIs for racket tracking and contact-label pre-fill behind the reviewed contacts; cached tracks convert to web-emulator sessions

meta_technology.name: Muse tool-use dataset
meta_technology.use: 2263 synthetic conversations whose tool results match the app exactly, for evals and tuning

agent_limits.fallback: built-in deterministic engine, UI names the engine that answered

hardware.imu: LSM6DSV320X (±4000 dps gyro, ±16 g and ±320 g accel, 1 kHz)

repo_map.apple/: iPhone + Mac app, Watch app, Ray-Ban Display HUD, Muse Spark agent, RacketKit Swift package
repo_map.firmware/: ESP32-C3 firmware: on-racket shot analysis, tap scoring, mic model, BLE protocol, OTA
repo_map.ml/: sweet-spot audio model, Muse what-if dataset generator, run reports
repo_map.backend/: Supabase schema and the muse edge function
repo_map.tools/: recording, labeling, checking, and agent-eval scripts
repo_map.data/: small calibration recordings (large raw sessions stay local)
repo_map.TennisRobot/ + robot/: camera + arm rig for repeatable ground truth (framework, simulated)
repo_map.video/: Remotion source for the demo video
repo_map.docs/: wiring, data collection, club report, privacy, TestFlight, build plan
repo_map.baseten/: Truss config to self-host Meta's open Muse Glimmer 30B (experiment)
